The token represents freedom of thought, questioning narratives, and exploring the unknown aspects of modern technology and media influence. Built on Solana for fast and low-cost transactions, $PBB combines viral internet culture with Web3 community power, creating a movement where believers, skeptics, researchers, and meme enthusiasts can all participate together.

Drop in a PDF or PowerPoint (up to 25 MB), and wooow re-renders every slide for mobile—no design app to learn, no app to install. How it works Sign in with Google or get a passwordless magic link delivered in under a minute—tap it and that’s your account. Drag in your deck and your custom URL is reserved instantly, so you can share it right away while conversion runs (roughly 1–2 minutes per slide). Close the tab and come back when it’s done. Then just drop your link in Slack or anywhere else: laptops see landscape, phones swipe. Built for sharing knowledge Every account comes with a public profile to house your whole library—lectures, explainers, tutorials, and weekly threads stacked in one place so people can find all your work. Decks are public by default, but you can switch any one to unlisted with a single tap. Browse decks others are sharing, or upload your own. One link, two faces. Stop telling people to “zoom in on slide 4”—send a link that already knows what screen they’re holding.
